scope: method-validation only; reduced ARX quarter-round, no key-recovery/full-round claim
quarter_round: a+=b; d^=a; d=rotl(d,1); c+=d; b^=c; b=rotl(b,2); a+=b; d^=a; d=rotl(d,3); c+=d; b^=c; b=rotl(b,2)
trail_engine: Propagate masks backward through exact XOR/rotation rules and the verified modular-addition Walsh coefficients. After every modular-addition expansion, merge duplicate four-word input masks into linear-hull coefficients, then retain the beam_cap largest absolute merged coefficients with lexical mask tuple tie-break.
exact_reference: Vectorized complete 2^20 truth table for each output mask followed by normalized Walsh FWT over all 20 input bits.

metrics.exact_support_energy: sum exact_coeff^2 over approximate nonzero support / total exact energy
metrics.full_l2_error: exact missing energy plus coefficient error on emitted support

regression: At n=2 with no beam pruning, complete trail enumeration must reproduce the exact quarter-round Walsh spectrum coefficient-wise within 1e-12 for a fixed output mask.
stage1_only_if_pass: Only on method-validation PASS may the trail engine be integrated into the existing q138/source-orbit punctured-map ranking, with offline trail construction, memory, pair processing, sorting and exact verification billed in TOTAL.
kill_rule: If n=2 exact reconstruction fails, stop as implementation invalid. If any fixed n=5 mask misses either 0.90 spectral-cosine^2 or 0.90 exact-support energy at beam4096, do not integrate this beam-trail engine into key recovery; record method-quality NO-GO at this budget.
forbidden: No output-mask reselection, beam-cap extension, threshold retuning or source-orbit ranking rescue after spectrum inspection inside this milestone.
